name: tools-unko-v1
title: UNKO v1.31 (Object Insertion Tool)
description:
An object insertion tool for SMW. Works similarly to GPS, except it inserts objects instead of blocks. An object can be thought of as a collection of blocks that is created at level load time. This can be used for convenience (for example: to wrap a complicated setup of multiple blocks into a single object), but also to make your levels smaller and save space.

Uses Asar v1.50.
